what: Robust Julia Setup for R Packages
title: Robust Julia Setup for R Packages
text: Robust Julia setup R packages wrap Julia engine. juliaready captures patterns learn hard way building R package calls Julia: Julia binary use several installed, install Julia packages cleanly without leaving depot unstable state, load .jl bridge files reliably, manage lazy initialisation. small, opinionated, meant replace ~100 lines brittle boilerplate per consuming package ~5. Internally uses JuliaConnectoR — keeping Julia separate process R — rather JuliaCall embeds Julia R process. Consumer packages call juliaready::eval_julia() / call_julia() / import_julia() rather underlying library directly, choice backend encapsulated.

title: Robust Julia Setup for R Packages
text: work simple case. JuliaConnectoR better default : shared-process segfaults. JuliaCall, R Julia share memory, threads, signal handlers, dynamic linker. one unhappy crashes . observed segfaults LD_LIBRARY_PATH poisoning subprocess Julia, Pkg.activate(<path>) followed Pkg.instantiate() -process JuliaCall, accessing fields NamedTuple results via julia_eval, . JuliaConnectoR puts Julia separate process; Julia segfault closes TCP socket R survives. Smaller list rules. list “things must ” much shorter --process Julia. Less remember, less break. Crash containment. bad simulation crash recoverable rather fatal. JuliaCall larger ecosystem frequent commits, activity platform-compatibility work; hard interaction (-process linking) fixed without changing architecture.

text: julia_bin() — resolve Julia binary, honouring JULIACONNECTOR_JULIABIN, JULIA_BINDIR, PATH. julia_ready(packages, github, state_env, install, project, verbose) — install required Julia packages subprocess, start JuliaConnectoR server using . project = "<path>", activates instantiates pinned Julia project (e.g. inst/julia/Project.toml) instead installing user’s default depot — recommended shipping reproducible installs. Idempotent. julia_load_bridge(package, files, verbose) — load .jl files inst/julia/<package> calling package via juliaEval. ensure_julia(state_env, init_fn) — lazy-init guard. Call top function use Julia. eval_julia(code) / call_julia(name, ...) / import_julia(module) — backend-agnostic wrappers around juliaEval / juliaCall / juliaImport.

what: What this package deliberately does not do
title: Robust Julia Setup for R Packages
text: pin specific Julia version. package needs , install via juliaup set JULIACONNECTOR_JULIABIN, wrap julia_ready() version check. auto-initialise .onLoad. Eager init .onLoad interacts badly compiled backends (notably Stan) can crash R package attach. Use ensure_julia() instead. provide Julia REPL. JuliaConnectoR’s job.
